source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    border_row = next((r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] and all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r])), None)
    if border_row is not None:
        direction, border = 1, border_row
    else:
        border = next(c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
        direction = -1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] and (r != border if direction == 1 else c != border)}
    components = []
    while points:
        start = points.pop()
        comp = {start}; stack = [start]
        while stack:
            r,c = stack.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in points and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == grid[r][c]:
                    points.remove(p); comp.add(p); stack.append(p)
        components.append(comp)
    components.sort(key=lambda co: max(r for r,c in co) if direction == 1 else min(c for r,c in co), reverse=(direction == 1))
    for comp in components:
        r0,c0 = next(iter(comp)); color = grid[r0][c0]
        for r,c in comp: out[r][c] = 0
        shift = 0
        while True:
            step = direction * (shift + 1)
            if any(not (0 <= r+step < h and 0 <= c+step*0 < w) or (r+step == border if direction == 1 else c+step == border) or out[r+step][c] != 0 for r,c in comp): break
            shift += 1
        for r,c in comp: out[r+direction*shift][c] = color
    return out
'''
